Module com.stockle
Package com.stockle.api

Class StockAPI

java.lang.Object
com.stockle.api.StockAPI
public class StockAPI extends Object
StockAPI handles all communication with the Alpaca Markets API. Provides methods to fetch stock data, quotes, historical data, and manage paper trading.

    • getHistoricalBars

      public List<StockAPI.BarData> getHistoricalBars(String symbol, LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate, String timeframe)
      Get historical bar data for a single stock.
      Parameters:
      symbol - Stock symbol (e.g., "AAPL")
      startDate - Start date for historical data (YYYY-MM-DD format)
      endDate - End date for historical data (YYYY-MM-DD format)
      timeframe - Bar timeframe (e.g., "1Min", "5Min", "1Hour", "1Day", "1Week", "1Month")
      Returns:
      List of bar data points sorted by timestamp
